rows.note: Focal fitted analysis: population-averaged NB2 GEE with log link and exchangeable within-property working correlation. Outcome was the quadrat count euc_sdlgs0_50cm + euc_sdlgs50cm_2m + euc_sdlgs>2m (the constructed total exactly matched euc_sdlgs_all in all 351 rows). Predictor was the sum of three percent-cover grass classes divided by 10, so the coefficient is the log expected-count ratio per 10 percentage points more total grass cover. Adjusted for survey-round fixed effects, Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m), and Euc_canopy_cover; no property fixed effects. NB2 alpha=9.118451809252402 was calibrated from a negative-binomial model with the same marginal mean specification. Bias-reduced sandwich SE clustered by Property; Wald t=-0.4403398301841893 with inferential df=17 (two-sided p=0.6652387103589308). Fitted n=348 after complete-case exclusion of 3/351 rows; 18 property clusters. Observation unit: one distinct 15 x 15 m quadrat sampled in one survey round. Design: repeated cross-sectional quadrats nested within properties over three survey rounds. The coefficient combines within- and between-property contrasts and does not fully control unmeasured property-level confounding. A property-fixed-effect NB2 sensitivity analysis gave estimate=-0.03097777475028581 and clustered SE=0.1334135490797365 but had separation-like coefficients because three properties had no recruitment.
rows.predictor: (ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover + NativePerennialGrass_cover) / 10; one unit is 10 percentage points more summed grass cover

rows.note: Negative-binomial NB2 regression with log link. Outcome: total Eucalyptus seedling count per physical 15 x 15 m quadrat-round, constructed as euc_sdlgs0_50cm + euc_sdlgs50cm_2m + euc_sdlgs>2m (identical to euc_sdlgs_all). Focal predictor: summed exotic annual, exotic perennial, and native perennial grass percent cover, divided by 10. Adjusted for survey-round fixed effects, Euc_canopy_cover, and Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m). Complete-case fitted n=348 of 351 rows; 18 property clusters and 3 rounds. Property-clustered sandwich SE with finite-sample correction; physical quadrats differ across rounds, so Quadrat no was not treated as a persistent unit. Native effect is the change in log expected total seedling count per 10-percentage-point increase in summed grass cover. Asymptotic z=-0.4851156252, two-sided p=0.6275943289; inferential df: none (asymptotic normal), model residual df=342. Estimated NB2 alpha=9.1184518093. The model converged. Observational adjusted association, not necessarily causal.
rows.predictor: (ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover + NativePerennialGrass_cover) / 10; one unit is a 10-percentage-point increase in summed grass cover

rows.note: Native effect and SE are on the Poisson log-mean scale. Test: property-cluster small-sample t = -0.8072312857494864, inferential df = 17 (18 Property clusters minus 1); two-sided p = 0.4306833282790776. Fitted n = 348 complete quadrat-round observations (3 of 351 excluded for missing grass cover, distance, or canopy cover). Observation unit: one distinct 15 x 15 m physical quadrat sampled in one survey round; reused Quadrat no labels were not treated as repeated physical quadrats. Outcome: total Eucalyptus seedling count, constructed as euc_sdlgs0_50cm + euc_sdlgs50cm_2m + euc_sdlgs>2m. Design/model: marginal Poisson-log GEE with exchangeable working correlation within the 18 Properties and property-cluster sandwich covariance; adjusted for categorical Season, linear Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m), and linear Euc_canopy_cover. The focal coefficient is linear on the log mean for each 10-percentage-point increase in the constructed grass-cover sum; no effect-scale conversion was applied.
rows.predictor: 10-percentage-point increase in total grass percent cover, constructed as (ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover + NativePerennialGrass_cover) / 10 in the model; positive movement means more grass cover
